title: Director, Demand Generation
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is redefining how professional services teams operate. With the launch of **Nitro**, our AI platform for Professional Services and Delivery teams, we've introduced agents (like the Migration Agent, Documentation Agent, Workforce Agent, and Signals) that fundamentally change what PS teams can accomplish. Nitro doesn't just automate work; it shows what's possible when AI is built into the fabric of how services are delivered.


We're not chasing the crowded install base. We're creating a new category, and we need someone who knows how to make a market believe in something before it's obvious.


**The Role**
------------


This is not a playbook\-execution job.


The traditional demand gen toolkit (Google Ads, webinars, event sponsorships) won't build the market we need. Our buyers (VPs of Professional Services) don't convert from a gated white paper. They convert when they *see* something that makes them think: "I had no idea that was possible."


Your job is to make them see it.


You'll own the full demand strategy for Nitro: discovering new channels before they're saturated, producing content that earns attention in an age where attention is the scarcest resource, and building a repeatable engine for channel exploration, not channel management.


You run experiments, not campaigns. You find channels, you don't inherit them.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


**Market Education \& Category Creation**


* Build the narrative around what AI\-native professional services *looks like*, using Nitro's Migration Agent and other agents as proof points
* Create content (especially visual/video) that shows possibilities, not just features
* Make VP PS the audience that forwards your stuff to their peers

**Channel Experimentation**


* Design a structured test\-and\-learn system to identify emerging, non\-obvious demand channels: dark social, niche communities, LinkedIn creator plays, short\-form video, practitioner\-led content
* Kill failing experiments fast; scale winners before they become crowded
* Maintain an active "channel hypothesis backlog" and always be running the next test

**Pipeline Creation**


* Drive qualified pipeline into sales through a mix of inbound pull and targeted ABX for high\-value PS leader accounts
* Partner closely with Sales to calibrate ICP, signal quality, and follow\-up sequencing
* Own the funnel metrics that matter: awareness velocity, ICP engagement, pipeline influenced, sales cycle acceleration

**Brand in Market**


* Position Rocketlane as the definitive voice in AI\-for\-PS, not just a tool vendor
* Build an external presence for Rocketlane's founders and subject\-matter experts as trusted voices in the PS community

**The Profile We're Looking For**
---------------------------------


### **The 2026 Demand Leader Is Different**


The old model (hire someone who managed $5M in Google Ads and ran quarterly webinars) is broken. The attention economy has made buyers immune to that playbook. We're looking for someone who has shown a consistent pattern of finding channels *before* they peak, extracting outsized value, and moving on before they become noise.


**You've got at least 2 big wins under your belt.** Not "contributed to growth." You *drove* something: a new channel that wasn't in the plan, a campaign that became the company's signature move, a GTM motion that others later tried to copy. You can tell the story in 60 seconds and back it up with numbers.


**You have a framework for finding and killing ideas fast.** A hypothesis backlog, a bias for cheap tests, and a ruthless ability to read signal from noise early. You've killed your own ideas before leadership told you to.


**You live in the attention economy.** You understand why a 90\-second LinkedIn video from a practitioner can outperform $50k in paid ads. You've used dark social, community seeding, and creator distribution, not because you read about them, but because you've run them.


**You've marketed something people didn't know they needed.** Category creation, new product category, or a feature set that required explaining the problem before selling the solution. You know what it feels like to market upstream of demand.


**You're a builder, not just a manager.** At our stage, the Head of Demand Gen writes copy, tests ads themselves, gets on calls with practitioners to understand the persona, and ships things without a full team behind them.
  

  

**You execute with a high quality bar.** You have taste and judgment for what great looks like. When you back an idea or hypothesis, you do it justice ensuring there's real confidence that it's been explored to its fullest potential, not just checked off the list.


**Must\-Have Experience**
-------------------------


* 7\-12 years in demand generation (B2B SaaS preferred, but strong B2C candidates with a track record of channel experimentation and audience building are equally welcome), with at least 2 stints where you were a key driver of measurable growth inflection
* Demonstrated ability to discover and exploit new/underused channels, with specific examples from at least 2 different companies (the same channel trick twice doesn't count)
* Experience marketing to senior buyers (VP / C\-suite) in enterprise or mid\-market B2B
* Proven track record with content\-led or video\-led demand motions, not just paid search
* Hands\-on experience with modern GTM tooling: Clay, HubSpot or equivalent, LinkedIn paid, intent data, influencer marketing, attribution approaches for dark social
* Strong creative judgment: you can brief a video, write a hook, and know when something will land

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Marketed an AI product, especially one that required educating the market on new possibilities rather than competing on features
* Experience at a company that grew through a "show don't tell" motion (demo\-led, video\-first, or practitioner\-community\-led)
* Background in or exposure to the PS / consulting / implementation world
* Built UGC or customer\-voice content programs
* Managed a small team or agency pod while also being personally hands\-on

### **What We Won't Hire**


* Someone who optimizes existing channels exceptionally well but hasn't *created* demand from new ones
* A "demand gen operator" whose primary skill is campaign setup and reporting
* Anyone whose answer to "how do you find new channels" is "I read industry reports and benchmark against competitors"
* Someone who needs 6 months to develop a strategy before testing anything

### **What Success Looks Like**


**90 days:** You've run 3\-5 channel experiments, identified 1\-2 high\-signal channels to double down on, and have a clear point of view on how Rocketlane Nitro should show up in market.


**6 months:** A repeatable demand motion is live. VP PS leaders in ICP accounts know Rocketlane and associate us with what AI\-native PS looks like. Pipeline from non\-traditional channels is measurable and growing.


**12 months:** Rocketlane is the brand that VP PS professionals cite when talking about AI transforming their function. You've built a channel playbook others would try to replicate.


### **Why This Role Is Special**


* You'll be working directly with the founders, with no 3\-layer approval chains
* You have a real product story to tell. Nitro's Migration Agent is genuinely new. The possibilities aren't marketing spin; they're real
* You'll have budget and latitude to experiment, not just optimize
* This is a category\-creation moment. The person who builds this playbook writes the case study that others reference for years

  

**Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* Impact and ownership: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* Work with the best: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* Celebrate wins: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* Learn and grow: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* Flexibility and balance: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).
  

  

*Rocketlane is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to building a team where everyone can do their best work.*

title: Demo Engineer
description:

Rocketlane is building a dedicated Demo Engineering function \- and this is the founding role. As a Demo Engineer, you own the demo infrastructure that powers how Rocketlane shows up in every prospect conversation. You're not just supporting a sales process; you're engineering the product experience that makes or breaks a deal.


**What you'll build and own**


* A library of demo environments across segments, personas, and use cases \- always clean, always current, always deal\-ready
* POC environments for enterprise and mid\-market evaluations, configured to mirror real customer scenarios
* Nitro (AI agent) demo flows \- you'll be the first person to productize how Rocketlane's AI capabilities are shown to the market

* A documentation system for demo configs, data scripts, and setup guides \- so the infrastructure scales beyond you

* Comfortable writing lightweight scripts or code (Python, JS, etc.)
* Detail\-oriented \- you notice when something looks off and you fix it
* Ramps quickly on new products and can map features to real\-world use cases instinctively
* 0–1 year of experience in a dev, QA, implementation, or similar technical role; strong fresh grads/interns welcome
* Bonus: exposure to PSA, PM tools, or platforms like Salesforce, Jira, or similar

**How you'll grow**


This is a new function at Rocketlane \- which means you're not walking into a defined box. You'll have direct visibility with the SE lead, product, and engineering. As Rocketlane scales, so does this function \- Demo Ops, Technical Enablement, or Solutions Engineering are all natural next chapters. And given you'll be building Nitro's demo motion from the ground up, you'll have a front\-row seat to how an AI product goes to market.


**You'll thrive here if you're**


A builder who takes ownership seriously. You see a broken demo environment as *your* problem to fix, not someone else's to report. You're curious about AI, care about craft, and want to build something that didn't exist before.

title: Forward Deployed Strategist
description:
**The role**
============


You sit where a customer's business goals, their operating model, and Rocketlane's platform actually meet. The customer can feel something's wrong but doesn't have language for it. That's where you start. You bring structure to the ambiguity without flattening it, turning incomplete signals into a direction someone with real stakes will commit to.


This is a strategist role that carries through to delivery. It owns the why, the what, the diagnosis, the strategy, the engagement design, and the measurable outcome. Own the outcome end to end.


**What you’ll do**
==================


**Immerse and diagnose**
------------------------


* Build a deep read of each customer’s delivery model, commercial priorities, and success metrics well beyond product adoption.
* Identify the highest\-impact problem worth solving, often before the customer has framed it themselves.

**Design the engagement**
-------------------------


* Scope transformation initiatives end to end from intake and discovery through delivery each mapped to a defined business outcome and a complexity tier.
* Set success criteria up front. Every engagement is measurable before it starts, so value realized is provable at the end.
* Run the discovery sprint that qualifies a request: confirm the problem is real, scope the work, and recommend whether it proceeds. You protect the function from under\-scoped or misrouted requests.

**Drive outcomes and expansion**
--------------------------------


* Run executive engagements that move the conversation from features to outcomes.
* Surface expansion and churn signals early and build the strategic case behind them you influence the commercial result, not just the technical one.
* Carry accountability for the value FDS delivers and prevent escalations.

**Shape the function**
----------------------


* Feed cross\-account patterns back into the product as the voice of the customer.
* Build reusable engagement models, intake criteria, and frameworks that scale across accounts. You help define what FDS looks like at scale, not just execute it.

**What we’re looking for**
==========================

  

  

* **Strategic, customer\-facing background** PS consulting, solutions strategy, Solution Architect, or management consulting.
* **Commercial instinct:** you read an account’s trajectory, frame risk, and find the expansion without being told where to look.
* **Comfort with ambiguity:** you take something genuinely messy, understand it, and make it actionable for someone who has to decide.
* **Exceptional communication:** equally fluent in an exec setting and in a working session. You compress complex ideas without dumbing them down.
* **PS / delivery literacy :**you understand utilization, margin, and project economics, not just CX metrics.
* **Technical fluency:** you know when integrations, APIs, and AI tooling matter to a design decision.

title: Customer Engineer
description:
**Customer Engineer — Rocketlane**


**About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing SaaS company redefining how professional services teams


deliver customer projects. We recently raised $60M in Series C led by Insight Partners,


bringing total funding to over $105M from investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and


Nexus Venture Partners. With Nitro, our agentic execution platform, we've built an


AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and


surfaces delivery risks, right inside customer project workflows. We're 200\+ people building a


product that services teams love, and we're just getting started.


**What will you do?**


As a Customer Engineer, you'll be the hands\-on technical engine behind how our customers


connect Rocketlane to the rest of their tech stack. Working alongside FDEs, implementation


teams, and Product Managers, you'll spend your time understanding a customer's tools,


platforms, and data, and then building the pipelines and integrations that make everything


talk to each other.


This is a Customer Engineering role where you won't be expected to run enterprise accounts


solo on day one. Instead, you'll join client calls, learn to read a customer's technology


ecosystem quickly, and take ownership of well\-scoped engineering work: data models,


integrations, scripts, and connectors. Over time, as your judgment and customer instincts


grow, you'll take on bigger pieces of the deployment and start feeding what you learn in the


field back into the product.


**You don't need prior work experience to be great at this role.** If your final\-year project, a


hackathon build, or a personal side project involved wiring systems together, wrangling


messy data, or building something people actually used — that's exactly the muscle this role


needs. If you love writing code and being close to the customer, and "pure backend


engineer" feels too far from the people using what you build, this role is for you.**What you'll be responsible for**


**Data engineering across the customer's stack**


Build and maintain data pipelines and integrations that connect Rocketlane with the


tools our customers already use (CRM, HRMS, ERP, finance tools, data warehouses,


internal APIs).


Model and shape messy, real\-world customer data so it's clean and usable in


production.


Write Python scripts and small utilities to move, transform, and validate data between


systems.


**Understanding the customer's technology ecosystem**


Learn how each customer's platforms, tools, and data fit together, and translate that


into a clear picture the team can build against.


Join technical discovery and working sessions with senior FDEs — listening, asking


sharp questions, and gradually taking on more of the conversation.


**Hands\-on engineering with AI**


Work with LLMs to build customer\-specific automations: from simple prompt\-driven


scripts to connecting Nitro agents to customer data.


Debug integration and data issues, do root\-cause analysis, and ship fixes quickly —


with support from senior team members while you're ramping up.


**Contributing back to the product**


Surface recurring customer patterns, edge cases, and gaps to Product and


Engineering.


Help build reusable templates, connectors, and internal tooling so each deployment


makes the next one faster.


**Must\-have skills**


**0–3 years of software development experience, or strong, demonstrable**


**project experience** (final\-year projects, internships, hackathons, or open\-source


work) — comfortable writing clean Python.


Solid grasp of **data structures, data modeling, and databases** — coursework or


project\-level SQL and an understanding of how data flows between systems is


enough.


Comfortable reading and working with **REST APIs**: testing endpoints, understanding


auth, and wiring up integrations — even if this was only done in a class project or


personal build.


Some hands\-on exposure to **LLMs**: prompting, calling model APIs, or building small


AI\-powered tools — a weekend project counts.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing, innovative SaaS company redefining how professional services teams deliver customer projects. We recently raised **$60M in Series C funding led by Insight Partners**, bringing our total funding to over $105M from top investors including 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, along with super angels like Gokul Rajaram, Girish Mathrubootham, and Clark Valberg.


Our mission? To move the professional services industry from tracking work to *executing it*. With **Nitro**, our agentic execution platform, we've built the industry's first AI\-powered engine that configures systems, runs migrations, generates documentation, and surfaces delivery risks \- directly inside customer project workflows. We're a team of 200\+ passionate folks building a product that services teams love, and we're just getting started on the Outcome Era.


**What will you do? (Role Overview)**
-------------------------------------


As a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** on Rocketlane's AI Implementation team, you will own the technical success of our strategic customers as they adopt **Nitro AI agents**. You'll embed with customer teams \- running discovery, designing agent workflows, configuring integrations, engineering prompts, and shipping production\-grade apps and agents that drive measurable outcomes.


This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success. You'll understand customer workflows, orchestrate agents, write code debug live issues, and translate what you learn in the field into product improvements that shape the future of Nitro. If "professional services consultant" feels too removed from the keyboard and "pure product engineer" feels too removed from the customer, this role is built for you.


You'll be a founding member of our AI\-first Professional Services org \- someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving puzzles, and is energized by seeing their work live in production within weeks, not quarters.


**What You'll Be Responsible For**
----------------------------------


### **Customer\-Embedded Agent Deployment**


* Own end\-to\-end deployment of Nitro AI agents for enterprise customers \- from discovery and solution design to configuration, go\-live, and ongoing optimization.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customer stakeholders (Services leaders, IT, Operations, Revenue teams) to map business workflows to Nitro agent capabilities.
* Design agent architectures that solve real delivery problems: migration agents, workforce agents, documentation agents and custom workflows tailored to each customer's environment.
* Build and deploy custom integrations between Nitro and customer systems (CRM, HRMS, ERP, Finance tools, data warehouses, internal APIs).

### **Hands\-On Engineering**


* Write production\-grade code/ scripts to extend, customize, or integrate Nitro agents into customer workflows.
* Engineer prompts, design evaluation frameworks, and tune agent behavior for customer\-specific data, terminology, and edge cases.
* Build data pipelines and connectors to feed agents with the right context \- SOWs, project history, customer communications, and structured delivery data.
* Debug live agent behavior in customer environments, perform root\-cause analysis on complex system interactions, and ship fixes fast.

### **Trusted Technical Advisor**


* Serve as the technical point of contact for strategic accounts throughout their Nitro implementation journey.
* Guide customers toward best\-practice implementations \- and push back when needed. Your job is to advise, not just execute requirements.
* Translate customer pain into clear problem statements, then into shipped solutions. Our model is simple: spend time understanding customer workflows, then build agents.

### **Product Feedback Loop**


* Be the voice of the customer inside Rocketlane. Surface patterns, edge cases, and feature gaps to our Product and Engineering teams.
* Prototype and validate new agent capabilities in the field before they become full product investments.
* Contribute to internal playbooks, reusable agent templates, and scaled enablement content so every FDE engagement makes the next one faster.

### **Pre\-Sales \& POC Support**


* Partner with Sales and Solutions teams on high\-stakes enterprise deals \- building rapid POCs, running technical validations, and proving the business case for Nitro.
* Represent Rocketlane's technical depth in customer executive conversations, demos, and architecture reviews.

**Must\-Have Skills**
---------------------


### **Engineering \& Technical Depth**


* **3–5 years of hands\-on software engineering/product management experience**, with the ability to write production\-grade code in at least one of Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar.
* Strong command of **REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth/auth flows, and enterprise integration patterns** \- you can read API docs, test endpoints, and ship integrations without hand\-holding.
* Good understanding of **data modeling and ETL** \- comfortable working with messy enterprise data and shaping it for production use.
* Comfortable with modern cloud, DevOps, and integration tooling (Postman, AWS/GCP, Docker, iPaaS platforms like Workato/Boomi/Make).

### **AI \& Agent Engineering**


* **Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and AI agent frameworks** \- prompt engineering, agent orchestration and evaluation/guardrails.
* Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Replit, Lovable, or similar) to move faster and build utilities that make deployments scalable.
* Strong intuition for when to use an agent vs. deterministic automation, and how to design human\-in\-the\-loop workflows that customers trust.

### **Customer\-Facing Instincts**


* 1\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role \- Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Technical Consulting, Implementation, or similar at a B2B SaaS or AI company.
* Proven ability to drive enterprise deployments end\-to\-end with minimal supervision, including discovery, solutioning, and leading technical conversations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication \- you can sit in a room with a VP of Services and earn their trust, then turn around and write clean technical documentation.
* Ability to simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders

### **Problem\-Solving \& Ownership**


* **Bias toward action and ownership.** You see a problem, you fix it. You don't wait for a ticket.
* Strong first\-principles thinking \- you can decompose a messy customer problem into a solvable, shippable plan.
* Thrives in ambiguity. Comfortable operating without a playbook, because you're often the one writing it.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
-------------------------


* Experience with **Professional Services Automation (PSA) tools** \- Rocketlane, Asana, Wrike, ClickUp, Salesforce PSA, Kantata, etc.
* Background in **Professional Services, Customer Success Engineering, or technical implementation** at enterprise SaaS companies.
* Prior exposure to building or deploying **agentic AI systems** in production at an AI\-native or AI\-forward company.

**You Should Apply If You:**
----------------------------


* Want to be at the frontline of deploying real, production AI agents that change how businesses operate \- not just build another chatbot.
* Love owning customer outcomes end\-to\-end and thrive on the blend of engineering and customer conversations.
* Get energized by solving puzzles in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being written.
* Are driven by autonomy, impact, and building something that scales \- and want to help define what "Forward Deployed Engineer" means at Rocketlane.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------


At Rocketlane, we're all about building a great product *and* a great place to work. Here's why you'll actually look forward to Mondays:


* **Impact and ownership:** You won't just be another cog in the machine; here, you're more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* **Work with the best:** We're a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* **Celebrate wins:** Whether we're hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* **Learn and grow:** We're all about learning \- and not just the latest SaaS trends. You'll grow your career, pick up new skills, and work on problems that most engineers only read about.
* **Front\-row seat to the AI era:** You'll build with frontier models, deploy real agents into real enterprises, and see your work drive measurable business outcomes in weeks.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits:** Comprehensive health coverage, flexible time off, and benefits designed to support you and your family.

**Who you are:**

CFD  

1\. Specializing in thermal simulations including fluid flow, heat transfer, multiphase flow and related engineering problems.

3\. Expertise in active and passive cooling systems to meet thermal criteria across applications.  

4\. Applications include data centers, telecommunication devices, storage devices, energy storage systems, thermostats \& display systems in medical devices and navigation systems in marine vehicles (heat dissipation ranges from 20W to 4kW or more).  

5\. Lead the development and implementation of thermal and mechanical requirements for server platform systems ranging from 1U to 10U form factors.  

6\. Conduct extensive thermal simulations using CFD tools on PCle and custom form factor circuit cards to verify designs: Generation of thermal curves to qualify thermal level of PCIe Cards.  

7\. Participate in thermal technology research and development to meet the thermal requirements of future IT equipments.  

8\. Executed estimation of material properties for efficient heat dissipation by mechanical testing, thermal testing, and surface testing and intrinsic transient testing; diagnosis of DoE and failure analysis based on CTQ specifications.  

9\. Thermal test validation of IT equipment including server/storage/switch product as per international standards.  

10\. Exhibit key DRC, LVS \& footprint and GERBER validation: Adopt thermal design for PCB placement and routing optimization as per the thermal simulations.  

11\. Drive fan tuning and system thermal optimization efforts.  

12\. Capability to analyze and reduce the system noise inside the enclosures by simulation output.  

13\. Knowledge on IP ratings of enclosures.


FEA


1\. Specializing in both Static and Dynamic Analysis, encompassing Shock, Vibration, Seismic, and Drop Testing.  

2\. Experience in physical testing of data center racks (various ranges up to 52U height) such as payload, tilt, impact and drop tests.  

3\. Experience in performing Seismic (Dynamic) analysis to meet the GR\-63 standards for indoor enclosures at high seismic zone (Level 4\).  

4\. Strong expertise in performing dynamic shock analysis to qualify products for Operational shock (40G) and crash hazard shock (75G).  

5\. Capability to perform dynamic vibration analysis to evaluate product for random vibration (0 to 500Hz) and shipboard vibration (4 to 33Hz).

8\. Capability to extract information about displacements, velocities, accelerations, joint reactions, and inertial loads of all the mechanism components, as well as the power necessary to sustain the motion.

* Specializing in thermal simulations including fluid flow, heat transfer, multiphase flow and related engineering problems.

title: Engineer, Product Applications
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  

  

  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Broadband Plasma (BBP) division is the market\-leading optical inspection system used by logic, foundry, and memory customers to detect critical defects at advanced nodes. These tools combine broadband plasma technology with unmatched sensitivity and speed to support high\-volume manufacturing.
**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.

  

  

**Application Development Engineer**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Customer support** : Product value demonstration during beta testing, Head\-to\-Heads (H2H) and tools in the ramp phase, thereby enabling product penetration/adoption at world\-wide customers. This includes\-investigating semiconductor manufacturing yield issues and providing inspection solutions; creating \& sharing product value statements and use\-cases with engineering, marketing and sales groups; training customers and other applications engineers.
* **Product Demonstration** : Provide specific product demonstrations on all aspects of highly complex products to customers and assess potential applications to meet customer needs
* **Product Characterization** : Work on test plan development and execute detailed characterization of the tool/algorithm performance and provides clear feedback to the Engineering teams for product improvement, especially during Alpha/Beta tests.
* **Problem Diagnosis/Troubleshooting** : Respond to customer requests and perform routine to moderately complex problem diagnosis and problem resolution.
* **Customer Relationship** : Interacts with customers to educate and coordinate activities. Good working knowledge of customer use case and is expected to understand customer needs and improve customer relations.
* **Training** : Conduct customer product demonstrations and technical training including on\-site training of Field Applications Engineers and end users.
* **Documentation** : Document all test results and lessons learned in BKMs (Best Known Methods), training documents, Demo reports, or, Alpha/Beta test reports and transfer product knowledge to Field Applications teams.
* **Presentation/Communication Skills** : Generate demo and test reports and strong presentation skills for internal and customer review.

**Requirements:**

* We are looking for high energy, self\-driven and motivated engineers who are interested in working in High Tech. The semiconductor space is a fast paced, high stress environment that gives applications engineers a lot of autonomy to work and drive projects on their own. Ideal candidates appreciate the opportunity to have high levels of accountability, working well with limited supervision and thrive in a work environment where they can drive projects on their own.
* Candidate must have Master’s or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Material Science, or related fields.
* Must have excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills.
* Candidate must be a strong team player.
* \>50% travel will be required

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years


**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  

  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  

  

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Associate, Central Monitor, Risk Based Monitoring
description:
The Senior Associate, Central Monitor is responsible for ensuring the completeness, quality and integrity of the subject data in the clinical trial database under Risk Based Monitoring (RBM) mode. The areas of activity include but are not limited to: developing Risk\-Based Monitoring system for applicable studies, ensuring key risk indicators (KRIs) properly defined and set up in the system to support the study, processing and reviewing study data in the system for the signal and action management, follow up for the issue resolution. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures risk based monitoring activities comply with regulations, applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Processes at all times and is familiar with supported systems (RBM system, etc.) and able to troubleshoot and provide rapid response for all database issues. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor ensures quality oversight/control steps implemented in the central monitor activities and may be required to perform tasks as CM Program Oversight Lead. The Senior Associate, Central Monitor works with the global study team to meet the study objectives.

  

• Implement global strategies, initiatives, processes, and standards to ensure consistent, efficient, and quality processes to meet quality, timelines and deliverables. • Provide technical expertise to set up and test study level Risk\-based Monitoring system


• Review study level system outputs to process for the signal and action management • Plan and execute communication plans \& methods to ensure customer satisfaction and enable improvements to be implemented during the course of a study.


* Able to resolve conflicts, influence and communicate with key stakeholders and customers.
* Implement quality oversight/control steps implemented in the central monitor activities.
* Review protocols to ensure the set\-up, review and reporting requirements can be met and are standardized.
* Provide technical oversight, guidance and coordination for all the central monitor activities.
* Set up and test RBM system at study level to ensure system quality.
* Define key risk indicators (KRIs) in study system, and ensure consistency between the standard level and the study level.
* Set up dictionary for data quality assessment DQA in study system
* Ensure RBM system align with the protocol and adhere to ICH GCP, SOPs, corporate standards and regulatory requirements.
* Work with Study Team to define the issue resolution for the reviewing findings as signal and action.
* Develop, implement and maintain Quality Control related documentations for RBM related activities to ensure data completeness and accuracy.
* Perform central monitoring activities including review system outputs, propose suggestion for signal and action management, and follow up with study team for the action resolution.
* Work with Clinical Data Scientist to ensure all signal and actions are properly mitigated and RBM systems properly released.
* Ensure lessons learnt during the course of the study are documented and shared with other central monitors/ study teams to facilitate cross\-study learning.

Legacy Databases

Data Architecture Patterns

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  

  

  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise.

  

  

### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a passionate **Quality Engineer** with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle.


### **Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system\-level testing.
* Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity.
* Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift\-Left quality practices.
* Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis.
* Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics.
* Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools.
* Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release\-readiness initiatives.

### **Required Skills and Qualifications**


* Strong software development experience using **C\#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language** .
* Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices.
* Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure.
* Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI.
* Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG.
* Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web\-service technologies.
* Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Hands\-on exposure to **Generative AI, AI\-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI** .
* Strong debugging, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years


**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  

  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  

  

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Controls Tech EIM Database Lead / Database Engineering Lead
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Position Overview**


Citi is seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database\-as\-a\-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi\-region banking systems.


**Responsibilities \& Requirements**
  

**1\. Enterprise Database Architecture \& Technical Strategy**
  

Architect, design, and deliver end\-to\-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis).
  

Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high\-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments.
  

Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero\-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
  

**2\. Modernization, DBaaS \& Cloud Enablement**
  

Lead migration initiatives from legacy on\-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS).
  

Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling.
  

Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re\-platform and refactor applications for cloud\-native persistence layers.
  

**3\. High Availability, Replication \& Scalability Engineering**
  

Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets \& Sharded Clusters).
  

Establish cross\-region and multi\-data\-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission\-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
  

**4\. Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning \& Diagnostics**
  

Spearhead deep\-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems.
  

Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks.
  

Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
  

**5\. Security, Vulnerability Management \& Access Control**
  

Enforce end\-to\-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in\-transit, and privileged access controls.
  

Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non\-compliant instances across the fleet.
  

Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role\-based access control (RBAC).
  

**6\. Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& CI/CD**
  

Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub).
  

Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation.
  

Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self\-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
  

**7\. Continuity of Business (COB) \& Disaster Recovery (DR)**
  

Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills.
  

Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point\-in\-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site\-level disasters.
  

Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
  

**8\. Governance, Risk, Audit \& Regulatory Compliance**
  

Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments.
  

Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates.
  

Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
  

**9\. Technical Leadership, Mentorship \& Vendor Engagement**
  

Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams.
  

Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures.
  

Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
  

**10\. Required Qualifications, Experience \& Certifications**  

**Education**: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

**Experience**: 12\+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3\+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large\-scale, enterprise financial services environment.
  

**Core Technical Competencies:**
  

In\-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12\+, Patroni, Connection Pooling).
  

Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures.
  

Demonstrated hands\-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform.
  

Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols.
  

Certifications (Preferred):
  

Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist
  

AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional
  

PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional
  

MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional
  

Key Leadership \& Soft Skills
  

Proven track record of managing high\-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion.
  

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
  

Strong ownership mindset, problem\-solving agility, and passion for continuous technology modernization.

The team works on quality management tools, workflows, reporting capabilities, and measure development that support clients in demonstrating improved quality of care. title: System Administrator I
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
### **Role Overview:**


The System Administrator I is responsible for the administration, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure within a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment. This role ensures high availability, performance, and security of systems across on\-premises and cloud environments.  

The incumbent will manage incident resolution, system maintenance, network configurations, and cloud operations, while delivering high\-quality support to internal stakeholders and customers. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and adherence to operational and security standards.### **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Incident \& Service Management  

* Monitor, triage, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs, ensuring timely escalation where required.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Document resolutions, root causes, and updates in accordance with operational processes.
* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Microsoft ecosystem and Windows server environments.


2\. System Monitoring \& Infrastructure Management  

* Proactively monitor infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog,PagerDuty).
* Respond to alerts across critical, warning, and error thresholds.
* Perform system upgrades, patch management, and scheduled maintenance activities.
* Manage and optimize server resources including CPU, memory, and storage capacity.


3\. Network Administration  

* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network connectivity including static, dynamic, and failover tunnels.
* Perform routing updates, ASA licensing activities, and IP whitelisting tasks.
* Execute network security tasks such as IP blocking (shunning) and tunnel resets.


4\. Identity \& Access Management (IAM)  

* Administer Active Directory (AD) user accounts, group memberships, and access policies.

* Support identity synchronization between AD and Okta environments.
* Provision and maintain internal and customer user accounts in alignment with security policies.


5\. Database Administration Support  

* Manage database\-level access control, including granting and revoking SQL permissions.
* Support integration of identity groups with database systems.


6\. Cloud Infrastructure (AWS) Management  

* Configure and manage AWS services including EC2, S3, and IAM components.
* Monitor cloud utilization and implement cost optimization measures.
* Perform scheduled backups, scaling, and disaster recovery support activities.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and application\-level issues within cloud environments.
* Integrate cloud services with on\-premises and third\-party systems.


7\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting  

* Diagnose and resolve system performance issues, IIS services, hardware concerns, and access\-related issues.
* Manage service configurations, permissions, and software installations.
* Support authentication\-related issues including MFA resets and monitoring tool components.


8\. AI Enablement in NOC Operations  

* Utilize AI tools to support operational efficiency in incident analysis and reporting.
* Perform summarization of alerts, logs, and incident data for operational insights.
* Develop structured prompts for root cause analysis, escalation notes, and customer communications.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs before operational use.
* Ensure adherence to data security and confidentiality standards when using AI tools.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in System Administration or NOC operations.
* Experience with monitoring tools..
* Strong knowledge of networking concepts including VPNs, tunnels, and ASA configurations.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SQL, and server administration practices.
* Ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast\-paced, 24/7 operational environment.

### **Preferred Skills:**


Technical Expertise:
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, systems, and cloud technologies.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for stakeholder interaction.
* Adherence to processes, documentation standards, and compliance requirements.

Analytical:
* Proven troubleshooting and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with internal and external teams.

### **Work Environment:**

* Hybrid work model (Work From Office / Work From Home).
* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts and weekends.
* Availability outside standard business hours based on operational requirements.

### **Behavioral Competencies:**



* Ensures Accountability
* Manages Complexity
* Communicates Effectively
* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively
  


PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. title: TIG/MIG Welder
description:
**Job Title:** TIG \& MIG Welder / Fabrication Specialist

**Position Summary:**

A TIG \& MIG Welder performs precise joining, fabrication, and repair of metal components using Tungsten Inert Gas (GTAW) and Metal Inert Gas (GMAW) welding techniques. The role requires strong blueprint reading, metallurgical understanding, and strict adherence to structural quality standards across steel, stainless steel, and aluminum assemblies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Fabrication \& Setup:** Read engineering blueprints and welding symbols to plan layout, cutting, and assembly sequences. Clamp, align, and tack\-weld components using jigs and fixtures prior to final welds.
* **TIG Welding (GTAW):** Perform high\-precision welds on thin gauge metals, non\-ferrous materials (aluminum, brass, copper), and critical stainless steel joints requiring smooth, high\-integrity cosmetic finishes.
* **MIG Welding (GMAW/FCAW):** Operate semi\-automatic wire\-feed equipment for structural steel fabrication, high\-volume production, and heavy\-gauge metal joining with high deposition rates.
* **Machine Calibration:** Adjust shielding gas flow rates (Argon, $CO\_2$, or mixes), wire feed speeds, amperage, and voltage based on material thickness, alloy type, and joint configuration.
* **Post\-Weld Finishing:** Clean welds using wire brushes, grinders, and pickling paste to remove slag, spatter, and oxidation. Grind, polish, or flush welds to client specifications.
* **Quality Assurance \& Safety:** Perform non\-destructive visual tests for defects like porosity, undercut, or lack of penetration. Maintain PPE protocols (auto\-darkening helmet, respirator, leather sleeves/gloves) and workspace safety standards.

**Education \& Certification**High school diploma or trade school certification in welding technology. AWS certifications (GMAW / GTAW) or ISO/EN standard certifications are highly desirable.

**Technical Expertise**Mastery of both pulse/dip TIG and short\-arc/spray MIG processes. Proficient in blueprint reading, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T), and weld defect troubleshooting.

**Physical Demands**Strong manual dexterity, steady hand control, ability to lift up to 50 lbs, and endurance for prolonged standing, bending, or working in confined spaces.

**Experience**Typically 2–4 years of combined TIG and MIG welding experience in manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, or custom metal fabrication environments.

description:
**Job Description**  

Job Summary :


Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day\-to\-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem\-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.


Role Definition :


Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.


Responsibilities :

* **Client Interaction** \- Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* **Client Access Setup –** Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues.
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting \-** They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible.
* **Issue Resolution** \- Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption.
* **Escalation** \- For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level.
* **Documentation** \- They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team.


Skills :

**Broad Knowledge** \- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.

**Problem\-Solving** \- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.

**Communication** \- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.

**Adaptability** \- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.


Tasks :

**Responding to Cases** \- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.

**Performing Diagnostics** \- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.

**Providing Solutions** \- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.

**Escalating Issues** \- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.

**Example Scenario** \- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:

* Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs.
* Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity.
* Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly.
* Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation.


Success metrics :

* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications

title: Lead Engineer
description:

* Collaborate with product owners, designers, and fellow developers in Agile/Scrum teams to determine design specifications and technical details.
* Work together with colleagues on internal infrastructure and process improvements.
**Application Maintenance \& Optimization**:

* Modify existing applications to correct errors, adapt to new software upgrades, or improve performance.
**Production Support**:

* Assist in production problem resolution as needed, including occasional off\-hour support.
**Key Competencies:**

**Technical Expertise**:

* In\-depth working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Hibernate/JPA, with current experience on Java 17/Java 21 (LTS) and Spring Boot 4\.x.

* Experience developing and automating unit tests using JUnit 5 and/or TestNG, with mocking/assertion libraries such as Mockito and AssertJ.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to support continuous testing and delivery.
* Experience with code management tools (e.g., Git, SVN) and website performance testing.
**Domain and Support Experience**:

* Automobile domain experience.
* Experience supporting global applications.
**Attention to Detail and Multitasking**:

* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and switch between tasks quickly.
**Additional Tools Knowledge (a plus)**:

* Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, Dynatrace, Postman, SonarQube, and JMeter.

* Apply strong web development experience in Java Technologies to build and support mid\- to high\-scale internet web sites.
**Quality Assurance**:

* Perform website performance testing and ensure solutions meet quality, performance, and reliability standards.

* Mobile application development.

title: Deputy Process Specilaist
description:
**Intercompany Specialist**

**Job Purpose**

The Intercompany Specialist is responsible for managing end\-to\-end intercompany accounting activities, ensuring timely reconciliation, accurate financial reporting, effective dispute resolution, and governance of intercompany transactions across global legal entities. The role partners with Finance Controllers, Operations Teams, and Global Process Owners while leveraging digital tools, analytics, and AI\-driven solutions to enhance process efficiency, transparency, and control.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Intercompany Accounting \& Reconciliations**

* Perform intercompany GL reconciliations for all legal entities across SAP and Non\-SAP systems.
* Prepare and validate intercompany accrual calculations during month\-end and year\-end close.
* Investigate and resolve reconciliation mismatches, accounting discrepancies, and open items.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

**Balance Monitoring \& Resolution**

* Monitor ageing intercompany balances and identify overdue or unresolved transactions.
* Drive timely follow\-up and resolution of disputes, mismatches, and outstanding balances.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis on recurring reconciling items and implement preventive actions.
* Maintain complete visibility of intercompany balances and provide regular reporting to stakeholders.

**Invoicing \& Transaction Management**

* Coordinate non\-trade intercompany invoicing activities across legal entities.
* Ensure timely processing, validation, settlement, and reconciliation of intercompany invoices.
* Support business stakeholders in resolving transaction\-related queries and accounting issues.

**Stakeholder Management \& Governance**

* Facilitate periodic review meetings with Unit Finance Controllers, Operations Teams, and Global Process Owners.
* Discuss intercompany balances, accruals, disputes, open items, ageing, and reconciliation status.
* Track action items and ensure accountability for timely resolution.
* Prepare governance reports, dashboards, and management updates.

**Digitalization, Analytics \& AI**

* Leverage AI tools and automation technologies to improve reconciliation efficiency, exception management, and reporting accuracy.
* Utilize data analytics to identify trends, anomalies, ageing risks, and process improvement opportunities.
* Support implementation and adoption of AI\-powered solutions for financial analysis, dispute management, and balance monitoring.
* Drive continuous learning and adoption of emerging AI technologies within Finance operations.
* Collaborate with Digital, Finance Transformation, and Process Excellence teams to automate manual activities and enhance controls.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities for process standardization, optimization, and automation.
* Support transformation initiatives focused on intercompany process excellence.
* Contribute to improvements in KPIs, SLA performance, and financial control effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline.
* 3\-5 years of experience in Intercompany Accounting, General Ledger, R2R, or Shared Services Finance operations.
* Experience with SAP ERP and financial reconciliation tools preferred.
* Exposure to digital finance transformation and automation initiatives is an advantage.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

**Functional Skills**

* Intercompany Accounting
* General Ledger Reconciliations
* Financial Close \& Accrual Accounting
* Financial Reporting
* Dispute Management
* Root Cause Analysis
* SAP / ERP Systems
* Stakeholder Management

**Digital \& AI Skills**

* AI Literacy and AI Adoption Mindset
* Data Analytics and Visualization (Power BI preferred)
* Microsoft Copilot / Generative AI tools
* Process Automation (Power Automate, RPA awareness)
* Data\-driven Decision Making
* Digital Transformation \& Continuous Improvement

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Problem Solving
* Attention to Detail
* Collaboration \& Influencing Skills
* Customer Focus
* Continuous Learning Mindset
* Proactive Ownership and Accountability

Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. title: TIG Welder/Fabricator
description:
TIG WELDER JOB Description

The TIG Welder will be responsible for the fitfing arid welding of aluminium, stainless steels and nickel alioy products using the TIG process with a great deal of precision. A welder must also be competent in using potentially dangerous equipment following all safety precautions. The ideal candidate will have a steady hand, knowledge of various types of metal and their properties and great attention to detail

Responsibilities and Requirements:

Set up and operate welding machines to TIG weld aluminium components, thin (0\.032\) stainless steel and nickel alloy components

Read and interpret blueprints and drawings

TIG weld aluminium or steel based on specifications AWS and aerospace welding specifications

Weld custom work

Prepare weld joints by using hand grinders and sanders

Maintain equipment in a condition that does not compromise safety

Observe all safety rules

Preform other duties as require to complete the job

Critical thinking and problem\-solving skills

Education and Experience:

Completion of one\-year certification program in welding from college or technical school or Two\-years related experience and or training or equivalent combination of both

Must be able to pass a weld test

Experience in TIG welding required

Must be able to pass all pre\-employment requirements.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
